title: Aveir DR Real-World Evidence Post-Approval Study
official: Aveir Dual-Chamber Leadless Pacemaker Real-World Evidence Post-Approval Study
summary: The purpose of this post-approval study is to evaluate the long-term safety of the dual-chamber Aveir DR leadless pacemaker using real-world evidence methods.
criteria:
Eligibility Criteria:

* Implanted with an Aveir DR leadless pacemaker
* Continuous enrollment in Medicare Part A and Part B for 12 months prior to implant and for -30 days after implant, except in the case of death within the 30-day period
* Ability to link with Medicare fee-for-service data
